data.title: Canadian dollar hits five-week high as data supports rate hike bets
data.description:
By Fergal Smith

The Canadian dollar strengthened to a five-week high against its US counterpart on Friday as oil prices rose and domestic retail sales data supported expectations the Bank of Canada would raise interest rates next week.

The loonie was trading 0.1% higher at 1.40 per US dollar, or 71.43 US cents, after touching its strongest intraday level since September 16 at 1.3969.

  • It left the currency on track for a seventh straight day of gains, which would be the longest daily winning streak since March 2022.

  • For the week, the currency was up 1% — heading for its biggest weekly advance since April.

  • Canadian retail sales rose 1.2% in August from July, led by higher sales at motor vehicle and parts dealers, while a preliminary estimate showed sales increasing by 0.7% in September.

  • "Given the resilience in these spending numbers, we still believe the Bank of Canada is headed for a rate increase next week," Oskar Stone, an analyst at Desjardins, said in a note, adding that the data points to third-quarter GDP growth of 2%.

  • The Bank of Canada will raise its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% on October 28 and follow with one more hike by the end of March to pre-empt any further rise in inflation expectations, according to a majority of economists polled by Reuters.

  • Investors see a roughly 80% chance the BoC hikes next week. Bets on a hike have increased in recent days after hawkish comments from Governor Tiff Macklem and as Alberta voted by a large majority to remain part of Canada. (0#CADIRPR)

  • The price of oil, one of Canada's major exports, rose after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concern over further disruption to energy supplies from the Middle East. US crude oil futures settled 3.8% higher at $103.27 a barrel.

  • Canadian bond yields rose across the curve, tracking moves in US Treasuries. The 10-year (CA10YT=RR) was up 5.1 basis points at 3.838%.

data.title: CO2NNEX(R) Digital Platform for Integrated Management of the Environmental Value of Sustainable Liquid Fuel (HVO) to Commence Operation in Demonstration of Sustainable Fuels Certificates Scheme
data.description:
TOKYO, Oct 23, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - Osaka Gas Co., Ltd. ("Osaka Gas") and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd. ("MHI") today commenced operation of CO2NNEX?(1), a digital platform jointly developed and deployed by the two companies, under the 2026 Project for the Establishment of Environmental Value Certification Scheme, etc. (Demonstration Project for Consideration of the Building of a Scheme for Certification and Transfer of Environmental Value of Sustainable Fuels) implemented by the Agency for Natural Resources and Energy of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry of Japan ("ANRE") (hereinafter referred to as "the Scheme Demonstration")(2). In the Scheme Demonstration, CO2NNEX will be used in consideration of the system requirements needed for the processes of issuing, transferring, and retiring sustainable fuel certificates.

Toward the widespread deployment of sustainable fuels (e-gasoline, SAF, HVO(3), e-methane, biogas, etc.), the adoption of sustainable fuels certificates scheme to certify and manage the environmental value of those fuels is being considered. The Scheme Demonstration is being conducted to examine issues in the adoption and the design of this scheme.

Osaka Gas and MHI aim to create value in the following forms through CO2NNEX, with a view to the widespread deployment of Sustainable liquid fuels and full-scale operation of the system in the future.

(1) Realization of digitalization and operational efficiency improvement for procedures, including collaboration with third-party certification bodies

Exchange of information between applicants and third-party certification bodies for procedures such as application, verification, and issuing of certificates will be completed on CO2NNEX. The introduction of a digital platform will enable the building of processes for prompt verification and issuance of certificates, minimizing the workload involved in procedures such as document handling. It will also enable reliable management of certificates without manual operations as the results of the digital authorization performed by the third-party certification bodies will be automatically reflected in transfer, retirement, and management processes after the certificates are issued on the system.

(2) Prevention of double-counting, enabling appropriate management and enhanced reliability of environmental value A mechanism to prevent double-counting of environmental value through the use of digital trust technology will be built into the system. System requirements will also be organized with the aim of contributing to a highly reliable certificate system design that will ensure traceability.

ANRE is also conducting a demonstration of a sustainable fuels certificates scheme for e-methane and biogas in the area of utility gas. Osaka Gas and MHI are making considerations for the use of CO2NNEX by the parties involved in that demonstration for e-methane and biogas. Going forward, Osaka Gas and MHI will contribute to the practical application of various sustainable fuels through the building and provision of system requirements with a high level of utility and reliability to meet the needs of future social infrastructure in the areas of both gas and liquid fuels.

(1) CO2NNEX:

CO2NNEX is a digital platform developed by MHI for the visualization and management of CO2 supply chain. In the Scheme Demonstration, Osaka Gas and MHI will use CO2NNEX to jointly consider the system requirements needed for the operational processes for issuing, transferring, and retiring sustainable fuels certificates. This system also has functions for transfer and management of attribute data for clean gas certificates used to certify the environmental value of e-methane and biogas, which have been used for purposes such as Expo 2025 and Nagaoka Methanation Demonstration."CO2NNEX" is a registered trademark of MHI in Japan and other countries.

For details, see the following press release:

"Operations Started for the Nagaoka Methanation Demonstration Utilizing the CO2NNEX? Digital Platform for Transfer and Management of e-Methane Clean Gas Certificates" (June 4, 2026)

https://www.mhi.com/news/260604.html

A demonstration conducted by the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry in fiscal 2026 for the phased establishment of sustainable fuels certificates scheme.

Hydrotreated vegetable oils, a biofuel produced by reacting vegetable oil or used cooking oil with hydrogen at a high temperature and pressure (hydrotreating) to improve properties such as oxidative stability. Mainly expected to be used as a substitute for diesel oil.

data.title: Seaport Research Issues Stark Nvidia Warning on Nvidia Stock
data.description:
Nvidia faces mounting competitive pressure and potential financial risks from its growing investment commitments, according to Seaport Research, which maintained its Sell rating on the chipmaker and a $180 price target.

Analyst Jay Goldberg said Nvidia's financing arrangements may reflect rising pressure from rivals. He also questioned whether the company's efforts to support customers and secure supplies could create competing demands on its financial resources.

Nvidia added roughly $250 billion in commitments during its latest quarter, according to Goldberg. Those obligations include spending to secure components and support data center construction, tying the company more closely to the expansion of AI infrastructure.

Goldberg also highlighted a separate financing initiative involving Nvidia, six private equity firms and banks. The proposed platform could provide about $500 billion in funding, with the possibility of reaching $1 trillion. Nvidia would not bear the entire obligation, but the analyst views its role as central to the arrangement.

The concern is that financing structures built to accelerate growth could magnify losses if demand for computing capacity weakens. Goldberg warned that infrastructure providers reliant on Nvidia's support could face pressure during a downturn, potentially adding strain when the chipmaker's own sales and cash flow soften.

data.description:
By Emese Bartha

U.S. Treasury yields rose Friday but remained near the previous day's lows as investors sought safety from the turmoil in French government bonds ahead of a closely watched interest-rate decision.

The Federal Reserve is expected to keep rates on hold Wednesday and resume a hiking cycle in December, as sticky inflation weighs on consumer sentiment while economic activity remains resilient.

The 10-year Treasury yield on Friday traded at 4.992%, slightly up from the day before but on pace for a weekly decline, according to Tradeweb.

data.title: The iPhone Duo Launch Kicks Off a Crucial Few Weeks for Apple — Barrons.com
data.description:
By Angela Palumbo

Apple released its long-awaited foldable iPhone on Friday, kicking off what is bound to be an exciting several weeks for the company as more product launches are expected and earnings are on deck.

Apple's iPhone Duo officially became available on Friday after years of customers and analysts waiting for the company to launch its own foldable device. The Duo is Apple's most expensive iPhone yet, with the 256GB model selling for $1,999 and the 2TB option going for $3,199.

Delivery dates for the iPhone Duo from Apple's website have been pushed to the end of January. That could signal solid demand, though limited supply may also be contributing to the wait.

"The Duo's sustained January delivery dates and reported order increase support a constructive early read, though the pace of the production ramp will be key," Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani wrote on Friday. He rates Apple as Outperform with a $380 price target.

Apple stock was down 0.4% on Friday to $347.01.

Duo started circulating this week after preorders for the device started on Oct. 16. While many reviewers have said they think the physical design of the phone is top-tier, there are still some kinks in the device that were pointed out — including an app optimization issue. Essentially, not all third-party apps have been updated for the new iPhone form factor, so some apps don't fill up the entire screen.

Apple said in a blog post on Thursday that developers are optimizing their apps for the Duo.

"The response to iPhone Duo from our developer community has been incredible, and we're inspired by how quickly they've embraced its larger display and new ways to interact," Susan Prescott, Apple's vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations, said in the post.

The iPhone Duo's selfie camera also isn't at the same level as those on other iPhones, which some reviewers say could be a reason to hold off on switching. But there's also been praise for the different camera features a foldable form factor offers, like being able to see the photo on one screen while taking a picture with the back camera, something that wasn't possible on an iPhone before.

Investors will be closely watching for sales data on the Duo in the coming weeks. It's especially important that the Duo does well as some analysts have reported that wait times — how long a customer has to wait for a product — for the iPhone 18 Pro lineup have been slowing.

The Duo launch also comes just before other important events for Apple.

Bloomberg reported on Monday that the company will unveil its first touch-screen MacBook at its Oct. 28 "Pro and tell" event in Los Angeles. This is another major change to an established product, and something customers have been waiting to see for years. A touchscreen MacBook Pro is likely to carry a hefty price tag, though. On top of the new screen capabilities, high memory costs could put further upward pressure on prices.

Apple also reports fiscal fourth-quarter earnings on Nov. 2. CEO John Ternus will be hosting the earnings call for the first time that day, and that call is likely to include analyst questions about demand for the iPhone 18 Pro and Duo, how memory costs are affecting margins, and how well the new artificial-intelligence-powered Siri is being received by customers.

Apple stock has done well this year ahead of all these important events, with shares up 27%. The stock even closed over a $5 trillion market cap earlier this month, and briefly surpassed Nvidia to become the most highly valued company in the world on Friday. The new product launches and earnings release will test whether the stock's resilience is sustainable.

Write to Angela Palumbo at angela.palumbo@dowjones.com

data.title: Iovance sees long-term response for Amtagvi in first-line melanoma
data.description:
Key points:
  • An analysis of phase 2 data found that a one-time treatment of Iovance Biotherapeutics' Amtagvi (lifileucel) combined with Merck's Keytruda (pembrolizumab) led to a 62.5% objective response rate and a 29.2% complete response rate after a median follow-up of 50.9 months as a frontline treatment for advanced melanoma.
  • Median overall survival, however, was not reached at the timepoint.
  • The analysis of the IOV-COM-202 trial also found that median progression-free survival was 19.8 months and the disease control rate was 83.3%.
  • Amtagvi, a polyclonal tumor infiltrating lymphocyte ("TIL") cellular immunotherapy, was granted accelerated approval in 2024 for individuals with unresectable or metastatic melanoma who failed on a PD-1 inhibitor.
  • Iovance has also started enrollment in TILVANCE-301, a phase 3 study examining Amtagvi in combination with Keytruda compared with Keytruda alone in patients with untreated, unresectable, or metastatic melanoma.

data.title: TSMC Stocks Rise as Record Profit Meets 2027 Caution
data.description:
Advanced-chip foundry TSMC reported its sixth consecutive record quarterly profit, with U.S.-listed shares up 1.89% to $420.14 at 10:50 a.m. ET Friday. AI demand is delivering hefty earnings. But management's caution around macroeconomic conditions adds a brake to the excitement as it plans for 2027.

Third-quarter net profit jumped 69% to NT$763.1 billion. Revenue reached $46.72 billion, with gross margin of 66.4% and operating margin of 58.7%. According to Reuters, TSMC expects fourth-quarter revenue of $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion and gross margin between 65% and 67%. AI-related demand still exceeds available capacity. The immediate challenge is turning that demand into shipments while keeping margins strong.

The valuation picture adds some discipline: a GF Score of 98 out of 100 highlights broad business strength, while the weaker GF Value component suggests valuation deserves closer scrutiny. Shares trade at 27.04 times earnings, with market capitalization around $1.93 trillion. Strong operations alone do not settle the investment case. Investors should watch two-nanometer adoption, advanced-packaging capacity and whether the next wave of capital spending earns attractive returns as new production comes online.

data.title: Rithm Capital Shares Gain on 3Q Earnings Beat
data.description:
By Elias Schisgall

Shares of Rithm Capital rose after the company's third-quarter earnings came in ahead of analyst expectations.

The alternative asset manager reported a profit of $253.3 million, or 38 cents a share, compared with a profit of $56.3 million, or 4 cents a share, in the second quarter.

data.title: Archer Aviation Stock Falls Despite Major Texas Air Taxi Expansion Plans
data.description:
Archer Aviation shares slipped about 2% in Friday morning trading despite the company outlining plans for electric air taxi networks across Austin, DallasFort Worth and Houston.

The proposed routes would connect major airports with commercial centers and popular destinations across the Texas Triangle, a region home to more than 20 million people. Archer sees the networks as a potential alternative to road travel in an area facing growing traffic congestion.

The company estimates its all-electric Midnight aircraft could reduce journeys that take 60 to 90 minutes by car to flights lasting just 10 to 20 minutes. The proposed service aims to make regional transportation faster while linking key business and travel destinations.

In DallasFort Worth, the network would connect six airports with business locations, including Frisco Station. Houston routes would link three airports with a downtown hotel helipad and Galveston. In Austin, planned connections include two airports and the Circuit of The Americas racing venue.

Chief Executive Adam Goldstein said the proposed networks are designed to improve connections between major destinations and reduce time spent in traffic. The company did not provide a launch timeline in the supplied information.

data.title: US yields climb, but 10-year holds under 5% as AI jitters linger
data.description:
Key points:
  • Yields higher after tumble in the prior session
  • S&P Composite PMI eases to 57.6
  • Two-year yield on pace for fourth straight week of declines

By Chuck Mikolajczak

US Treasury yields rose on Friday, a day after the benchmark 10-year yield saw its biggest one-day drop in nearly four years, but remained under the 5% mark as concerns about the durability of a rally in AI-related stocks lingered.

The yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note rose 3.7 basis points to 4.99%. The 10-year yield is down about 11 basis points on the week and on pace for a third straight week of declines, its longest run lower since June.

Investors have shifted toward safer assets such as government debt on recent concerns about the sustainability of the AI trade, a major component of the current bull market for equities. The bond market's recent rally has come even as economic data point to continued price pressures and oil prices have advanced above $100 per barrel.

But while the S&P 500 technology sector was higher as AI fears cooled, the broader S&P 500 CBOE:SPX retreated.

The 10-year yield plunged 19.3 basis points on Thursday, its biggest drop since March 10, 2023, when SVB Financial Group was closed by regulators after the bank's failed attempt to raise capital.

"We're going to see yields over 5% for the 10-year again. We're not that far away, but this is not like, 'oh, okay, we're off to the races here,'" said JoAnne Bianco, partner and senior investment strategist at BondBloxx Investment Management in Chicago.

"There are still all these headwinds in terms of sticky inflation, growing Treasury supply to finance the deficits, just the need in general, with all the uncertainty that we have for higher term premiums and then higher energy prices that seem to be here to stay for a while."

COMPOSITE INDEX SLIPS FROM PEAK

Yields rose further after S&P Global said its flash US Composite PMI Output Index, which tracks the manufacturing and services sectors, slipped to 57.6 this month from a five-year-high of 58.4 in September, though it remained well above the 50 threshold that signals expansion.

The yield on the 30-year bond (US30YT=RR) added 2.9 basis points to 5.316%, but was down nearly 13 basis points on the week, also on track for a third straight week of declines.

Even as economic data points to rising price pressures, market expectations for a rate increase from the Federal Reserve at its policy meeting next week have wilted. The probability of a hike of at least 25 basis points has shrunk to 9.4%, according to CME FedWatch, from 15.5% a week ago and 70.9% a month earlier.

A closely watched part of the US Treasury yield curve measuring the gap between yields on 2- and 10-year Treasury notes (US2US10=TWEB), seen as an indicator of economic expectations, was at a positive 29.6 basis points.

The University of Michigan's Surveys of Consumers showed its Consumer Sentiment Index dropped to 48.0 this month from a final reading of 48.1 in September.

The 2-year (US2YT=RR) US Treasury yield, which typically moves in step with interest rate expectations for the Fed, climbed 5.5 basis points to 4.69%, putting it down about 5 basis points on the week, which would be a fourth consecutive week of declines, its longest stretch of the year.

The breakeven rate on 5-year US Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) (US5YTIP=TWEB) was last at 2.456%, on track for its highest close since September 10, after closing at 2.38% on Thursday.

The 10-year TIPS breakeven rate (US10YTIP=TWEB) was last at 2.346%, indicating the market sees inflation averaging about 2.3% a year for the next decade.

data.title: Moderna Executives Sold Shares in Trades Planned Before Vaccine Results — WSJ
data.description:
By Theo Francis

Two Moderna executives sold more than $30 million in shares in the weeks after a closely watched cancer vaccine study triggered a surge in the stock price-and before more detailed results reversed some of the gains, securities filings show.

The sales by Chief Financial Officer James Mock and President Stephen Hoge were made under pre-set trading plans the men adopted in June. That was a couple months before Moderna's shares more than doubled Aug. 19, when it announced its mRNA-based vaccine had prevented melanoma from returning or spreading.

Hoge sold nearly $27 million in shares in mid-September and mid-October after exercising options scheduled to expire in February. Both times, he kept close to half the shares received from the options, valued at about $25 million at the time. Mock sold $2 million in shares received by exercising stock options and another $2 million in other shares on Sept. 10. The executives' share sales were at prices ranging from $134 to $217.

Moderna shares fell nearly 18% Thursday after details from the cancer-vaccine study were shared on social media, raising concerns the treatment might not be as effective as initially hoped.

The sales look routine, said Ben Silverman, head of research at VerityData, which tracks insider stock transactions for investors. Moderna shares were trading around $50 when the executives adopted the trading plans in June, and most of the sales came before the stock's significant run-up in October.

This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).

data.title: CBOT corn weakens as harvest advances
data.description:
Chicago Board of Trade corn futures eased on Friday as the harvest advanced in the US Midwest and traders positioned ahead of the weekend, according to analysts.

  • Dry weather conditions have been beneficial for harvesting in the US Midwest this week, but showers are expected to expand across the region next week, according to Commodity Weather Group.

  • Analysts said market players were attempting to minimize its headline risk ahead of the weekend, creating lackluster trade.

  • Some US farmers were finishing their soybean harvest after a stretch of favorable Midwest weather and were shifting to harvesting corn, according to analysts.

  • The US Department of Agriculture confirmed private sales of 116,000 metric tons of US corn to unknown destinations.

  • South Korea's Feed Leaders Committee (FLC) bought around 65,000 metric tons of animal feed corn in a private deal earlier this week without issuing an international tender, European traders said on Friday.

  • CBOT December corn (CZ26) settled 4-1/2 cents lower at $4.56 a bushel.

data.title: Dell Stocks Rise 2.1% as New AI Systems Face a 2027 Delivery Test

The rollout gives investors two timelines to watch. According to Data Center Dynamics, the smaller Vera CPU server arrives this month, while the Vera rack and Groq 3 inference system are scheduled for the first quarter of 2027. The products broaden Dell's AI offering, but some of the shipping opportunity sits next year. DCD

Demand is building. Dell said its AI Factory with Nvidia now serves more than 6,500 customers, compared with 5,000 last quarteran increase exceeding 30%. Its preceding earnings release reported $60.9 billion in AI-server orders, $16.4 billion in AI-server revenue and a $95 billion ending backlog. That backlog represents roughly 5.8 times the quarter's AI-server revenue. It signals substantial business to fulfill, without telling investors exactly when those orders become sales. investors.delltechnologies.com

The valuation raises the stakes: Dell trades 91.39% above the $241.66 GF Value estimate, leaving a substantial premium against that benchmark. Customer growth helps explain the enthusiasm. Protecting that enthusiasm takes execution. Dell needs to meet launch dates, turn orders into shipments and preserve margins along the way. Cash conversion matters, too. Rising inventory and receivables can soak up cash even while revenue accelerates. The next test is how much profitable cash Dell can generate from the demand already on its books.
